description: This file provides utility functions for mapping statuses and strings to color values, primarily used for visualizing statuses with consistent and distinguishable colors in a dark-themed dashboard.

methods.name: colorFromString
methods.description: Deterministically generates a pastel HSL color string from an input string, producing distinct hues for different strings.

methods.name: getStatusColor
methods.description: Maps a status string to a themed color based on predefined mappings or generates a deterministic color for unknown statuses.
